reserves.name: BTC collateral in Mezo ActivePool
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Bitcoin network, Mezo collateral system, and supported BTC bridge issuers

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-7 (lead tusd-trueusd)

sources.label: Mezo MUSD liquidation and redemption mechanics

reserveReview.rationale: The live capture reports one row, BTC collateral in Mezo ActivePool, at 100% of that pool's collateral; it is not MUSD's whole backing book. This classification-only review classifies that keyed ActivePool slice and certifies no whole-book weight or liability attribution. Mezo documents the ActivePool as the collateral account for its Liquity-style CDP path; collateral returns on repayment, is paid on redemption, or moves through the StabilityPool and DefaultPool on liquidation. MUSD is also issued through an EnclaveDebtManager path whose veBTC collateral sits in a Mezo Enclave outside the ActivePool, and that weight is not measured here.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mezo ActivePool live-reserve capture and MUSD collateral documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: MUSD issued outside the ActivePool, including the EnclaveDebtManager veBTC path, is not measured by this review; only the ActivePool slice is classified.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The observed BTC collateral is an external cryptoasset exposure rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.
